Container.Name: WARNO-Dedicated-Server
Container.Overview:
This container runs Eugen's official WARNO dedicated server. The form writes login.ini, variables.ini, and params_for_ai.json for you.

Request access from eugsupport@eugensystems.com with the email of your EugNet account. Eugen replies with a login and key pair; enter both exactly as written. One pair can run five servers. The key stays in this container's Unraid settings and in login.ini inside the settings folder. Do not put it in GitHub, and do not paste it into an issue.

The preset is a 2v2 Conquest server for Jungle Law from the Red Dragon map pack, Steam Workshop item 3811913066. Map is RDPort_JungleLaw_2v2_CONQ. A base-game scenario ID works too if you clear Workshop Mod List. Players subscribe to the mod in Steam and enable it in WARNO.

Eugen recommends host networking, and this container uses it, so there is no Docker port mapping. Forward the game port as both TCP and UDP to this Unraid server. The server also needs outbound internet access to reach Eugen.

For another server, add a new container from this same template. Change the container name, the game port, and the settings folder. Use the same login and key.

This template was built with AI coding assistants. Humans reviewed what shipped and remain responsible for it.

Config.Name: Settings Folder
Config.Description: Generated settings for this server, including login.ini. Use a different folder for each server, such as /mnt/user/appdata/warno2/settings. Do not commit this folder to a public repository.

Config.Name: Eugen Login
Config.Description: The login Eugen sent back with your dedicated key. This is unique and must be obtained from Eugen.

Config.Name: Eugen Dedicated Key
Config.Description: Dedicated key from Eugen's reply. It is written to login.ini on this server only. One login and key pair can run five servers.

Config.Name: Public WAN IP
Config.Description: Address Eugen's lobby tells players to connect to. Use your router's public WAN address for internet play, and forward the game port to Unraid. Domain names won't work.

Config.Name: Game Port
Config.Description: Port the server listens on. Host networking: the port must be free on the Unraid server itself. Forward this same port as both TCP and UDP to the Unraid server. Each server container needs its own port.

Config.Name: Server Name
Config.Description: Name shown in the WARNO server browser.

Config.Name: Map
Config.Description: Scenario ID the server loads. Base-game IDs come from Eugen's map list, such as _2x2_Hesse_2vs2_CONQ. Workshop maps use the scenario ID from the mod, such as RDPort_JungleLaw_2v2_CONQ. The display name Jungle Law will not work. Clear Workshop Mod List when using a base-game map.

Config.Name: Max Players
Config.Description: Total human players. A 2v2 server uses 4.

Config.Name: Minimum Players
Config.Description: Players required before the match countdown starts. Cannot be higher than Max Players.

Config.Name: Team Size
Config.Description: Maximum players on one team. A 2v2 server uses 2.

Config.Name: Combat Rule
Config.Description: 1 is Destruction. 2 is Conquest. Jungle Law is Conquest, so leave this at 2.

Config.Name: Workshop Mod List
Config.Description: Workshop mods joining players must have, written as id/version. The Red Dragon map pack is 3811913066/0. Separate extra mods with a hyphen. Clear this field to require no workshop mods.

Config.Name: Workshop Mod Tags
Config.Description: Browser icons for the required mods. Maps-Scenarios matches the Red Dragon map pack. Valid tags are Gameplay, Interface, Maps, Scenarios, Music, and Sound.

Config.Name: Write Config From Form
Config.Description: true rewrites login.ini, variables.ini, and params_for_ai.json from this form every time the container starts. Set false only to keep hand-edited files. Hand edits are overwritten while this is true.
